visual_style: The same framing before and after, labelled, with a wipe from one to the other.
rights_requirements: Comparisons are fair and clearly labelled; an illustrative simulation is never shown as a measurement.
render_notes: BEFORE / AFTER chips; the after shot wipes in over the before.
A split shot can show both at once (the before picture in the bottom panel).
format: a labelled before (the place as it was), a wipe to the after (as it is now), and what changed
best_for: news about a place, building or landscape that changed: a monument damaged or destroyed, a disaster's aftermath, a flood or fire, a demolition or restoration, climate change
